title: ELEVATE-GenAI: Reporting Guidelines for the Use of Large Language Models in Health Economics and Outcomes Research: an ISPOR Working Group on Generative AI Report

bias_targets.methodology: The paper proposes reporting guidelines that recommend using fairness metrics (e.g., demographic parity, equalized odds) and subgroup analyses to evaluate output consistency and ensure the model suggests gender-specific health states that reflect documented epidemiological data rather than perpetuating biases.

The paper proposes reporting guidelines that recommend using fairness metrics and checking whether the model suggests age-specific health states reflecting true epidemiological data to avoid perpetuating biases.

The paper proposes reporting guidelines recommending the assessment of demographic representation in outputs and the use of fairness metrics (e.g., demographic parity) to evaluate bias across ethnic subgroups.
The paper proposes reporting guidelines recommending the evaluation of model outputs across socioeconomic status groups to ensure equity and avoid reinforcing harmful stereotypes or exclusions.
